ratios.quote: The Credit Facility contains certain covenants, which, among other things, require the maintenance of (i) a total leverage ratio of not greater than 3.00 to 1.00 and (ii) a minimum current ratio of not less than 1.0 to 1.0 as of the last day of any quarter.

The Credit Facility contains certain covenants, which, among other things, require the maintenance of (i) a total leverage ratio of not greater than 3.00 to 1.00 and (ii) a minimum current ratio of not less than 1.0 to 1.0 as of the last day of any quarter.

parsed.notes: The excerpt gives only the covenant requirements and no actual ratio values. The 2.50x (and 2.0x free-cash-flow trigger) leverage tests apply only to Restricted Payments, so they are left out as conditional tests rather than maintenance covenants. The Senior Notes covenants under the Note Purchase Agreement (3.00x total leverage, 1.50x asset coverage, and the 2.00x restricted payments test) are excluded because they belong to the notes, not the bank credit agreement.
